limitations: This is a count-only preflight, not a model smoke or evaluation; no output was generated and no scoring was run.

Canonical follow-up counts include the reviewed synthetic tool result and a representative function call, but cannot include provider-generated model content or thought signatures. Runtime countTokens checks the actual follow-up before any generation request.
The per-request input ceiling and USD smoke spend ceiling are not approved; generation is blocked until both are recorded.
CountTokens pricing and quota treatment remain unknown and are not included in the generation-token estimates.
Published-list cost estimates assume no cache discount and use F-004 rates valid through 2026-12-31.

method.request_shape: generateContentRequest including model, contents, systemInstruction, tools, toolConfig, and generationConfig
method.sdk_note: google-genai 2.34.0 Developer API CountTokensConfig rejects system_instruction, tools, and generation_config; the S2 client uses the documented REST request shape.

request_attempts.note: The successful count total includes one repeated initial-case verification. Four earlier count-only requests were rejected while correcting the REST request shape.
